key_insight: Surrogate-guided reinforcement learning enriched perovskite recipe shortlists near high-performing measured devices, without establishing experimental performance.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help prioritize perovskite solar-cell recipes for fabrication across a large composition, device-layer, and processing space.
method: Use a frozen Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) to guide recipe generation.
Compare three learned policies with six baselines using 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run.
Assess candidate support through neighborhoods in a reference pool of 890 measured devices.
evidence_signal: In top-100 shortlists, PPO and recurrent PPO achieved neighborhood-supported hit rates of 23% and 24%, versus 2.9% for Pure Random and 10% for the strongest baselines on this metric.
watch_item: Only 11.7% of 9,000 generated recipes matched a composition family at similarity 0.90; experimental performance, seed robustness, and matched-budget advantage remain unestablished.
paper_title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
